info.title: context-bridge
info.description: Zero-dependency MCP memory server for AI coding assistants. Runs as a Windows Service with in-process ONNX embeddings and SQLite vector search.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ContextBridge MCP memory server — management CLI

commands.name: install
commands.description: Register and start the ContextBridge Windows Service (requires admin)

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompts and accept all defaults [default: False]

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Stop and remove the ContextBridge Windows Service (requires admin)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the current state of the ContextBridge Windows Service

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download the embedding model to the data directory

commands.name: configure
commands.description: Configure MCP clients to connect to ContextBridge
